title: Space Junk
description: My very first mod, testing out all the features of the tool MCreator.
body:
Hello! This is my first, and possibly last mod. It was created with MCreator.

This mod is meant to extend minecrafts progression severely, with the whole mod taking place post-wither.

There is currently no in game way to see how to get into the mod, so here is a tutorial to get into it.

### STARTER TUTORIAL
Try finding meteors made out of lunar basalt. Surround it with lapis inside a crafting grid to get an enchanted version, and create a portal frame out of it. Then try finding an Empty Moon Stone, and combine it with a nether star to get the Moon Stone. The Moon Stone can then be used to light the portal and start the mod.

From there, you can use advancements to figure the rest out.

### EXTRA NOTES
As it is so early in development, alot is uwnown, like if has incompatibilities, or what versions it works with. It was built for 1.21.8 though. (Multiplayer has been tested and seems to work fine(?))

### ISSUES
-Lunar basalt doesnt drop
-Can sometimes snow on moon
-Martian spire sometimes doesnt give loot
